definitions.explanation: A person who writes books, especially fiction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{作家|さっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧{作家|さっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a writer in the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{作家|さっか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read that author's new book.

notes:
{作家|さっか} refers to writers, especially novelists and literary authors.

FORMS:
⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (create) + ⟦{家|か}→家：noentry⟧ (professional suffix)

USAGE:
Primarily refers to literary writers—novelists, fiction authors, etc.

RELATED PROFESSIONS:
- ⟦{小説家|しょうせつか}→小説家：03070_shousetsuka⟧: novelist
- ⟦{脚本家|きゃくほんか}→脚本家：13962_kyakuhonka⟧: screenwriter
- ⟦{漫画家|まんがか}→漫画家：08643_mangaka⟧: manga artist
- ⟦{随筆家|ずいひつか}→随筆家：noentry⟧: essayist
- ⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧: poet
- ⟦ライター→ライター：00350_raitaa⟧: writer (general, often for non-fiction)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {作家|さっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a writer
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{作家|さっか}: famous author
- {作家|さっか}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: writing career
